exposure: Six delivery risk phenotypes based on delivery mode, labor, and ROM duration
cesarean section with ROM < 18 h without labor
cohort: 2937 preterm infants born at less than 35 weeks gestation at four perinatal centers from 2017 to 2021
finding: The incidence of early-onset sepsis (EOS) was highest (23.8 cases per 1000 preterm infants) in infants born after prolonged rupture of membranes (ROM) ≥ 18 hours.
mod_finding: No EOS cases occurred in infants born via cesarean section without ROM (with or without labor) or cesarean section with ROM < 18 hours without labor.
